descriptions.preferred: ACER PALMATUM 'RUTH'S RED' UPRIGHT RED 'RUTH'S RED' JAPANESE MAPLE ZONES 5-9 'Ruth's Red' was found as a chance seedling by Greg Gulden in Pennsylvania and named after his mother. 'Ruth's Red' has proven to be an outstanding upright deep maroon Japanese maple. Some consider 'Ruth's Red' to be one of their favorite red uprights as one of the darkest purple Japanese maples. 'Ruth's Red' turns to a fiery red to deep purple in the fall. We expect 'Ruth's Red' to reach 10-12 ft in 15 years.

descriptions_zh.preferred: ACER PALMATUM 'RUTH'S RED' 直立红叶日本枫，适生分区 5-9。'Ruth's Red' 是 Greg Gulden 在宾夕法尼亚发现的一株偶然实生苗，并以其母亲命名。该品种已被证明是一种表现极佳的直立型深栗紫色日本枫。有些人认为 'Ruth's Red' 是他们最喜爱的红叶直立型品种之一，也是颜色最深的紫红色日本枫之一。秋季时，'Ruth's Red' 会转为炽烈的鲜红至深紫色。预计 15 年可长至 10-12 英尺高。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多；部分选育品种常会很快售罄，建议尽早购买心仪品种。
